title: Robot Character Sheet
description: A 4x4 grid displaying multiple posed views of a retro golden robot with blue and red torso panels against a red background. The top three rows show the robot from front, three-quarter, side, and back angles at consistent scale, while the bottom row contains four smaller full-body front-facing versions.
prompt: A retro golden robot toy with blue chest plate and red accents, shown in a 4x4 grid of multiple angles including front, side, three-quarter and back views on a solid red background with faint geometric patterns. The robot has a smooth plastic-like surface, simple mechanical joints, and a helmet-like head with a neutral expression. Clean studio lighting with soft highlights, presented as an upscaled digital artwork from a character design study.
